questions.stem_text: What are the two principal answers to whether life has any meaning for us?

options.B: the existentialist's view and the nihilist's view
options.C: the deterministic view and the free will view
options.D: the materialistic view and the spiritual view
options.E: the empiricist's view and the rationalist's view
